newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end higher, Roche jumps.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end higher, Roche jumps.

text.p: 1545 GMT - Swiss shares ended higher as a rising dollar and gains on Wall Street boosted share prices, dealers said.
Book-squaring ahead of year-end also helped push up the bourse, but the volume was thin, they added.
Some short-covering was seen after the SMI Index jumped over the 3,900 points, a dealer said.
* SMI of leading shares ended 52.4 points or 1.35 percent higher at 3,922.2 points.
* Roche registereds jumped 300 francs to 10,435 francs, after setting a new all-time high of 10,440 francs.
Novartis registereds rose 24 francs to 1,509 francs.
Further industrial stocks were sharply higher, including ABB, Holderbank, Sulzer and Georg Fischer and SMH.
Most financials also firmed, while CS closed unchanged at 137.25 francs. Elektrowatt also was unchanged and ended at 534.
One of the losers was Phonak, shedding 35 francs to 1,065. Kuoni and Moevenpick also were lower.
